title: Variable Screw
pitch: One screw mesh that changes length through data and snaps only to sizes the catalog ships.
howItWorks: Currently, it's just a demo of how a single mesh can be repurposed for different lengths of screws by simply sliding through variable lengths. The primary goal is to recycle a single mesh and texture for better performance in medical application.

decisions.choice: One of the decisions was to create a shader version of the screw.
decisions.alternative: While the Helix version looked more realistic from different viewing angles, it cost more performance.
decisions.why: On the other hand, the shader is just faking the spirals, so it can be used on lighter devices.

next: Currently, the goal is not to develop an entire medical VR application, but we aim to create small projects like these that eventually can be assembled to create a full-fledged VR application when requested.
builtWith: Built with Claude Code + MCP for Unity + Blender MCP. Design decisions and explanation: Mohitur Rahman Zidan.

disclaimer: Sizes, colours and catalogs are illustrative example data, not clinical guidance.
